name: academic-figures-drawer
title_zh: 论文配图直接产出可编辑 draw.io 源文件
tagline_zh: 从摘要、代码或参考图出发，生成 ICML/NeurIPS 级别的框架图、张量流、消融对比图。改字体、调颜色。
tagline_en: From abstracts, code, or reference images to camera-ready framework diagrams, tensor flows, and ablation.
desc_en: Create camera-ready, editable draw.io figures from papers, method descriptions, code, or reference images. Use for ICML, NeurIPS/NIPS, ICLR, and similar ML/AI research figures: concise framework overviews, module-detail diagrams, tensor and attention flows, ablations, training/inference pipelines, and downstream-task panels. Optionally use image generation for a non-semantic visual concept or inpu
why_zh: 它把「看懂论文结构」和「画图」拆开：先解析你的方法描述，再映射成 draw.io 的图层与连线。
why_en: It separates understanding from drawing: parses your method description, maps it to draw.io layers and connectors, outputs.
limit_zh: 只认机器学习/深度学习论文的常见图型（框架、模块、张量流、消融、流程）。不处理复杂数学公式排版、不生成矢量插图风格。
limit_en: Only for standard ML/DL figure types (frameworks, modules, tensor flows, ablations, pipelines). No complex math typesetting, no freehand.
title_en: Turn paper ideas into editable draw.io figures
